{{Quote|Check the old war bunker on the beach near the city. I've heard it has been overrun by Skaak Tippers, so be prepared for anything. Examine anything of interest you find in the bunker.|[[Wilson Tchorshel]], to a spacer|<ref name="AED" />}}
An '''old war bunker''' was situated along a [[Beach/Legends|beach]] a short distance northeast of the [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Kaadara]] on the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]] [[Planet/Legends|world]] of [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]]. During the [[Standard day/Legends|days]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]], the [[Royal Naboo Security Forces/Legends|Royal Naboo Security Forces]] used the bunker as a research facility to learn more about [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation]] [[Droid/Legends|droids]]. By the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], the bunker was overrun by a criminal organization known as the [[Skaak Tippers]].<ref name="AED" />

==History==
{{Quote|That was a research bunker. Naboo officers examined Trade Federation droids there. The better we knew what made them tick, the better we were able to stop them.|[[Colonel/Legends|Colonel]] [[Quarsh Panaka/Legends|Panaka]], to a spacer|<ref name="AED" />}}
[[File:OldWarBunkerInterior.jpg|250px|thumb|The interior of the old war bunker]]
The old war bunker began was originally a research facility for the [[Royal Naboo Security Forces/Legends|Royal Naboo Security Forces]] to learn more about the [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation]] [[Droid/Legends|droids]] in the [[Standard day/Legends|days]] leading up to the [[Battle of Naboo/Legends|Battle of Naboo]].<ref name="AED" />

Later, during the time of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] following [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]], the bunker had become overrun by a criminal organization known as the [[Skaak Tippers]].<ref name="AED" /> In [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]],<ref name="SWG_timeline">{{SWG_timeline}}</ref> [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] [[Special Agent/Legends|Special Agent]] and [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Lieutenant/Legends|Lieutenant]] [[Maximilian Vox]] suggested that [[Spacer/Legends|spacers]] [[Confiscation of Skaak Tipper weapons crates|investigate]] the bunker to find information about [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Old Republic]] experimental droid [[Artificial intelligence/Legends|artificial intelligence]]. In doing so, a spacer discovered a mysterious [[Computer/Legends|computer]] inscribed with barely legible text reading "[[Willoc]]," who was actually a [[Sergeant/Legends|sergeant]] of the [[Royal Naboo Security Forces/Legends|Royal Naboo Security Forces]]. When the spacer used the computer, [[Colonel/Legends|Colonel]] [[Quarsh Panaka/Legends|Quarsh Panaka]] urged the spacer to see [[Gender/Legends|him]] in [[Kaadara]], as it had been over a [[Standard week/Legends|week]] since he had last heard from him.<ref name="AED" />

==Behind the scenes==
The old war bunker was a location in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="AED" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> The old war bunker was added to the game as part of the "[[W:c:swg:Legacy Quest|Legacy Quest]]" with the release of the "[[W:c:swg:Publish 25 Notes for November 15, 2005|Publish 25]]," a.k.a. the "[[W:c:swg:New Game Enhancements|New Game Enhancements]]," on [[November 15]], [[2005]].<ref name="SonyCite-Publish Archive 2005">{{SonyCite|url=players/content.vm?id=64886&resource=publish|text=Publish Archive 2005}}</ref>
